## sminer config

Show the effective configuration and where it lives

### Synopsis

Show the effective configuration and where each value came from.

Precedence, highest first: flags, SMINER_* environment variables, the config
file, built-in defaults. Every key can be set by environment: classifier.model
is SMINER_CLASSIFIER_MODEL.

```
sminer config [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for config
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string   config file (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/sminer/config.yaml)
      --db string       database file (default $XDG_DATA_HOME/sminer/sminer.db)
      --json            print machine-readable JSON on stdout
      --no-color        disable color (also NO_COLOR=1)
      --offline         never call the network; heuristics and local clustering only
  -q, --quiet           print nothing on stderr except errors
  -v, --verbose         print detail on stderr
```
